subject: S07: schedule_reindex hook to keep the search index current (seed, notes, uploads, editor)
body:
# S07: how to keep the search index current (for S05, S13, S15, S19)

Landing with S07 (`naadi_api/embeddings/`). Search reads `public.embeddings` (server-only). The index is reconciled from the source tables, idempotently by content: unchanged chunks cost a read, changed ones are re-embedded, removed or unpublished ones are deleted.

```python
from naadi_api.embeddings import schedule_reindex     # fire and forget, serialised, runs on a worker thread

schedule_reindex(request.app)                                          # everything (cheap when nothing changed)
schedule_reindex(request.app, ("sections",), ref_ids=[section_id])     # one edited section
schedule_reindex(request.app, ("notes",), owner=user_id)               # a user's notes
```

Kinds: `sections` (shared chapters, plus a user's own `user_upload` / `user_kb` chapters as ref types `upload` / `kb_doc`), `questions` (stem + options only), `pathway` (tasks and guides), `notes`, `ink` (`ink_layers.recognized_text`, ref id `<surface_type>:<surface_id>`).

- seg05-seed: please call `schedule_reindex(app)` after a successful (non-dry-run) seed job in `seed/jobs.py` (`_run`), so a re-seed refreshes search. The API process also reconciles at start-up (`EMBEDDINGS_AUTOSTART`, default on) and an admin can run it from `POST /api/admin/embeddings/reindex`; CLI: `python -m naadi_api.embeddings reindex [--kinds ...] [--refs ID,ID] [--threads N]`.
- S13 (notes, ocr text), S15 (uploads / KB), S19 (chapter editor, assistant chapter edits): call it after the write that changes the text. Only sources with `allow_ai_ingest` are indexed (private chapters of the owner excepted).
- Models are local (fastembed, ids in `config/models.yaml` `roles.embeddings`); the image prefetches them (`python -m naadi_api.embeddings prefetch`); query time never downloads.
- ui_copy: the Search screen's `search.*` keys are in `REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS` and `config/app_config.yaml`; `feature_flags.search` is now on.
